{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: completed orders from LOYAL customers
filtered = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
filtered = filtered[filtered['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered['revenue_numeric'].mean()

print(f"Number of completed LOYAL orders (after removing QA): {len(filtered)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
